corrections.text: The last battle where my husband and the others fought
corrections.reason: The term denotes Misumi's husband, corroborated by chapter48_additions glossary and the grief context; it is not generic beloved ones.

corrections.text: You'll let us fight, won't you,
corrections.reason: She asks consent to participate, not merely whether her feelings are understood.

corrections.text: You'll let us fight, won't you?

uncertainties.note: Second independent full-scene source review by Terra chapter12_review supports Kyuuma and Subaru sharing Misumi's feelings; the protagonist's following plural acceptance supports retaining this reading. Root's alternative interpretation was rejected.

omissions.note: Explicit source pauses, cries and genuinely interrupted thought are retained, not filled out with invented conclusions.
